problem: Production could carry the exact main SHA while the versioned immutable English cache remained incomplete, causing fail-closed local builds to report 1,926 missing translations and leaving /en/prijzen with Dutch visible copy.
root_cause: A previously generated and offline-validated complete cache blob existed but never became the canonical main cache authority. Later exact-source promotions therefore reproduced the incomplete committed cache while provider metadata still matched main.
prevention: The canonical committed bg-static-i18n-en.json must be the proven complete cache blob, not a partial historical cache.
Static cache completeness must be verified offline against the exact protected candidate before production promotion.
Canonical small patch fragments may override or extend the complete base cache but must never substitute for base-cache completeness.
LIVE_BEWEZEN requires exact Netlify commit_ref plus visible English browser proof, not SHA identity alone.

evidence.production_browser_failure: English route still shows the Dutch pricing H1

semantic_learning.root_cause: The exact production SHA can still serve incomplete static English output when the committed base translation authority is partial; SHA parity and cache completeness are independent invariants.
semantic_learning.prevention: Require the proven complete base cache plus canonical patch fragments to validate offline against the exact candidate before production promotion.
semantic_learning.proof: Protected candidate must pass cache regression and production visible-English NL→EN→NL browser proof.
